blurb: CRAVE offers classic and contemporary American cuisine with sushi options. They provide dine-in, online ordering for pickup and delivery, catering services, and private dining rooms for events. They have special menus for occasions like Mother's Day and happy hour specials.
extraNote: Pre-order for private dining due 72 hours prior to event · Happy hour available only in bar area, varies by location and day · Kids Eat Free Sunday thru Thursday (not valid on Mother's Day) · No allergen-free guarantee; cross-contamination possible
